acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: Precursor fragmentation was achieved through higher-energy collision disassociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 25, an AGC target of 100,000, and an isolation width of 1.3 m/z.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Lysates were thawed at room temperature, and supplemented with 5 mM chloroacetamide (CAA) and 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP), just prior to sonication using 10 s pulses at 30 W.
Following sonication, MS lysates were supplemented with 5 mM CAA and 5 mM TCEP, and incubated at 37 °C for 30 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Homogenized lysates were digested by addition of Lys-C (Wako) to a 1:200 enzyme-to-protein ratio, overnight and at room temperature.

All mouse samples and the majority of all cell line samples were further digested with Asp-N (Roche), and some initial cell line samples were digested with either trypsin (Thermo), Glu-C (Promega), or wild-type alpha-lytic protease (WALP; Sigma).
